mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% indicates a severe labor market weakness that typically precedes central bank policy easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based deterioration in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-crisis recovery phase, a decline in the federal funds rate relative to its recent peak (e.g., below 0.25%) signals continued monetary accommodation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during the post-crisis recovery phase when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% signals weakening consumer spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS MoM change < -0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 0.5% annualized growth signals an economic slowdown that typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 annualized growth < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
